name: Test Injection Priority
comment: Synthetic injection grammar with L: prefix (priority -1) for testing injection-wins-on-priority and injection-wins-on-score branches in MatchRuleOrInjections. The L: prefix means this injection wins tie-breaks at the same match position.

inject-symbols.comment: Matches one or more @ symbols. Base grammar does not recognize @ at all, so this pattern enables the matchResult==null branch (base no match, injection wins) in MatchRuleOrInjections.
inject-symbols.name: punctuation.injected.priority
